edges.reason: Constructor derives the initial owner from _msgSender().
transfer sends tokens from _msgSender().
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as spender to decrement allowance.
_transfer checks _isBlackListedBot[msg.sender] before moving funds.
_transfer checks _isBlackListedBot[tx.origin], making the check origin dependent.
block.timestamp is passed as the router swap deadline.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
lock() computes _lockTime = block.timestamp + time, a timestamp dependency.
unlock() is gated by block.timestamp > _lockTime, a timestamp dependency.
_transfer triggers swapAndLiquify when the contract balance exceeds the threshold.
_transfer forwards sender, recipient, amount and takeFee to _tokenTransfer.
transfer() calls _transfer.
transferFrom() calls _transfer.
_tokenTransfer dispatches non-excluded transfers to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee with computed fee values.
swapAndLiquify swaps the sellable token portion for ETH.
swapAndLiquify adds the retained token portion as liquidity.
swapTokensForEth passes tokenAmount, path and deadline into the router swap call.
addLiquidity passes tokenAmount, ethAmount and deadline into addLiquidityETH.
uniswapV2Router is the target contract of the swap call.
uniswapV2Router is the target contract of the liquidity call.
swapAndLiquify computes marketingAmt and sends it out as ETH, an external call before completing accounting.
swapAndLiquify sends teamAmt ETH to _teamwallet, an external value transfer.
_marketingAddress is the destination of the marketing ETH transfer.
_teamwallet is the destination of the team ETH transfer.
withdrawStuckETH sends ETH to a caller-supplied recipient via transfer.
withdrawForeignToken performs an arbitrary external ERC20 call.
withdrawStuckETH is protected by the onlyOwner modifier which compares msg.sender.
withdrawForeignToken is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
setSellFee is onlyOwner guarded.
setBuyFee is onlyOwner guarded.
setBothFees is onlyOwner guarded and can set arbitrary fee levels.
setMaxTxPercent is onlyOwner guarded.
_setMaxWalletSizePercent is onlyOwner guarded.
setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled is onlyOwner guarded.
halloffameinu burns user balances and is onlyOwner guarded.
lock() is onlyOwner guarded and can renounce owner control.
updateMarketingWallet writes the _marketingAddress state variable.
updateteamWallet writes the _teamwallet state variable.
updatePartnershipsWallet writes the _partnershipswallet state variable.
addBotToBlacklist writes the _isBlackListedBot mapping.
setguesttime writes the guesttime flag.
setSellFee mutates the sellFee struct.
setBuyFee mutates the buyFee struct.
setBothFees mutates the buyFee struct.
setBothFees mutates the sellFee struct.
setMaxTxPercent writes _maxTxAmount.
_setMaxWalletSizePercent writes _maxWalletSize.
setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled writes swapAndLiquifyEnabled.
halloffameinu calls _transferStandard to burn each flagged bot's balance.
guesttime gates adding the recipient to botsWallet when from == uniswapV2Pair.
uniswapV2Pair is compared against from and to to decide swap and fee behaviour.
swapAndLiquify derives denominator, unitBalance and payouts from fee arithmetic without bounds.
setMaxTxPercent computes _tTotal.mul(maxTxPercent).div(10**3) with unbounded input.
The amount parameter flows into the ETH transfer in withdrawStuckETH.
The recipient parameter flows into the ETH transfer in withdrawStuckETH.
The tokenAddress parameter builds the IERC20 instance used in the external call.
The recipient parameter flows into the foreign token transfer.
The amount parameter flows into the foreign token transfer.
The newAddress parameter is assigned to _marketingAddress.
The newAddress parameter is assigned to _teamwallet.
The newAddress parameter is assigned to _partnershipswallet.
The account parameter is written to the blacklist mapping.
The account parameter is located and cleared from the blacklist mapping.
The time parameter is added to block.timestamp to set _lockTime.
The maxTxPercent parameter scales _tTotal when setting _maxTxAmount.
The to parameter is used as the transfer recipient and limit-checked address.
The from parameter is used as the transfer sender and blacklist-checked address.
The amount parameter is the amount moved by _transfer.
The constructor assigns the immutable uniswapV2Router.
The constructor creates and stores the uniswapV2Pair.
The router swap returns ETH to this contract, invoking receive() mid-execution.
The ETH transfer to the marketing wallet can re-enter the transfer path if the recipient is a contract.
